blocks.content: That portion of the tangent which is intercepted between the point of contact and $OX$ is called the length of the tangent ($=TP_1$), and its projection on the axis of $X$ is called the length of the subtangent ($=TM$). Similarly, we have the length of the normal ($=P_1N$) and the length of the subnormal ($=MN$).

blocks.label: text
blocks.content: The length of tangent (= $TP_{1}$) and the length of normal ($=P_{1}N$) may then be found directly from the figure, each being the hypotenuse of a right triangle having the two legs known. Thus

blocks.content: The student is advised to get the lengths of the tangent and of the normal directly from the figure rather than by using (5) and (6).

blocks.label: text
blocks.content: When the length of subtangent or subnormal at a point on a curve is determined, the tangent and normal may be easily constructed.
